prompt:
Use case: compositing.
Asset type: finished wide horizontal banner for the original space strategy game Stellar Syndicates.
Input image 1: the approved SINGLE-S Stellar Syndicates logo. This is the exact brand emblem to place in the banner, not a suggestion to redesign.

Create a premium 3:1 landscape banner, approximately 2400 x 800, using the supplied logo as the emblem on the left and a large two-line wordmark on the right. Vertically center both as one balanced horizontal lockup. Allow generous outer safe margins, a clear gap between emblem and lettering, and no clipped logo, glow or text. The emblem should occupy roughly one quarter of the usable banner width, while the wordmark occupies the rest.

Preserve the supplied emblem's identity and geometry faithfully: exactly one large angular metallic S with its connected diagonal middle stroke, the central cyan four-point star, elliptical cyan orbit, dark beveled hexagonal frame, gold pointed accent at the top, red pointed accent at the bottom, brushed gunmetal and silver surfaces. Scale it uniformly. Do not replace it with a double-S monogram, add another S shape, mirror it, crop it, or change its proportions. The single S must remain clear at banner viewing size.

Text (verbatim, only text in image):
STELLAR
SYNDICATES
Spell exactly S T E L L A R and S Y N D I C A T E S. Use strong custom uppercase geometric science-fiction lettering, broad proportions, readable letterforms, tasteful angular cuts, precise optical spacing. Match the emblem with brushed silver/titanium faces, shallow beveled edges and subtle cyan highlights. Balance the two lines to a similar overall width by adjusting letter size and tracking. Keep the letters crisp and clearly legible; no ornaments interrupting letterforms.

Place this assembled logo on a full-bleed deep midnight navy/near-black outer-space background with very sparse fine stars and a subtle restrained dark-blue nebula haze toward the edges. Soft cyan atmospheric light may anchor the emblem without excessive bloom. The background stays darker and quieter than the emblem and title. The final banner is opaque; composite the transparent supplied logo naturally onto the background, with no black rectangle around it.

The result should look like a polished official game identity banner: confident, clean, dramatic but controlled. No taglines, captions, labels, extra logos, extra symbols, watermarks, borders, interface elements, ships, characters, or presentation mockup. One complete banner, not multiple options.
